description:
Music for Overthinkers | Dilruba Raga Kedar | 1.5 Hours of Mental Quiet

When your mind won't stop — replaying conversations, rechecking worries, racing through tomorrow — rest can feel impossible.

This peaceful Indian ambient meditation music is designed to slow mental chatter, soften anxious thought loops, and give an overthinking mind somewhere gentle to land.

Enjoy 1 hour 30 minutes of expressive bowed dilruba melodies blended with warm tanpura drone, soft ambient textures, and slow settling phrases that gradually quiet the mind.

Perfect for overthinking relief, anxiety relief, meditation, mindfulness, evening wind-down, stress relief, journaling, reading, deep breathing, and peaceful nighttime listening.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Dilruba (bowed strings) & Tanpura Drone
Raga: Raga Kedar — the settling evening raga
Style: Indian ambient meditation / slow healing instrumental
Mood: Gentle, warm, settling, reassuring
Atmosphere: Mental quiet, anxiety relief, evening calm
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play this when your thoughts are loud — in the evening after a stressful day, during meditation or breathwork, while journaling, or in the hour before bed. Keep the volume soft and let the bowed dilruba slow your thinking down. For the most immersive experience, use headphones or listen in a quiet room.
